string.text: Complete a classic 9x9 Sudoku: every row, column and 3x3 block must contain the digits 1–9 exactly once.
Fill a classic 9x9 Sudoku without repeating a digit in any row, column or block.
Sudoku solved. Victory has been recorded for this attempt.
Arrows — cursor Enter — ink / pencil 1–9 — digit Space / 0 — erase
Changing difficulty will reset the active Sudoku game. Change difficulty?
The active Sudoku game will be lost. Start a new puzzle?

Fill all 81 cells with digits from 1 to 9. Every digit must occur exactly once in each row, exactly once in each column and exactly once in each outlined 3x3 block. Victory is recorded only when the whole grid is correct.
Given digits cannot be changed. Easy starts with exactly 45 clues, Normal with 36, and Hard with no more than 28. Every mode uses the standard 9x9 Sudoku rules with 3x3 blocks.
Enable Pencil, select an empty cell and press a digit to add or remove a small note. Pencil marks are reminders only and are ignored when the solution is checked.

Click a cell, then use the on-screen keypad. Erase cell clears its final digit or pencil marks. Arrow keys move the cursor; 1–9 enters a digit, Enter switches between final digits and pencil marks, and Space, 0, Backspace or Delete clears the selected cell. Undo is shown only when a move can be undone.

Closing the PDA or leaving the tab keeps the exact board for the current session. Loading a save resets the active board but keeps the selected difficulty. After victory the solved attempt is locked: Undo and Restart are hidden, while New Game creates a fresh random puzzle.

F5/F9 and menu loading preserve the exact active game during the current game process. The reward is fixed when an attempt starts and cannot be rerolled by loading. Easy gives no reward. A completed board cannot be replayed; New game creates a new attempt.
